equations.momentum: -grad(p) + eta*laplacian(v) + f = 0; eta constant and div(v)=0
equations.stress_note: For constant eta and incompressibility, div(2 eta e)=eta laplacian(v). This identity must NOT replace variable-viscosity stress divergence in R4.3.
equations.pressure: dynamic pressure with zero domain mean; not absolute pressure, not input to a pressure-sensitive rheology
equations.coordinates: uniform rectangle; x right, z upward from bottom; metres. R2 inward depth requires an explicit transform.
equations.boundary: all four walls impermeable/free slip: zero normal velocity, zero normal derivative of tangential velocity
equations.forcing: explicit body-force density at interior velocity faces, N/m^3; consumed once; no hidden density, gravity, plate velocity or slab traction
equations.time: snapshot time in a named epoch labels the input only; no elapsed interval is integrated

discretisation.placement: MAC: pressure at cell centres, u and w on their respective faces; normal wall DOFs eliminated
discretisation.order: centred second-order space on the registered smooth rectangular cases
discretisation.adjoint: G=-D.T with uniform cell/dual-cell weights; no checkerboard pressure null mode
discretisation.gauge: symmetric augmented [A,G,0;G.T,0,c;0,c.T,0], c=ones/sqrt(Np); multiplier checked, no continuity row dropped
discretisation.normal_path: matrix-free native stencils + MINRES with exact discrete separable velocity inverse and identity pressure/gauge preconditioning
discretisation.preconditioner: orthonormal DST-I on normal velocity nodes, DCT-II on tangential centres; velocity eigenvalues are sums of 4 sin^2(k*pi/(2n))/h^2, inverted by division; mean-zero pressure Schur block is identity in this special constant/free-slip geometry
discretisation.reference_path: small independently assembled sparse Kronecker/face-incidence system, SuperLU factor reused; explicitly selected, never fallback
discretisation.density_interpolation: optional explicit arithmetic cell-to-interior-face average on this uniform support; not a general conservative remap
discretisation.tensor_and_signs: assembled A=-laplacian, G=grad p, rhs=f; hydrostatic and warm-upward body-force tests. Tosi's printed sign ambiguity is NOT resolved by asserting a full convection comparison.

numerical_contract.dtype: binary64; no fast-math or precision downgrade
numerical_contract.scaling: reuse explicit R3 DiffusiveScales and constant RheologyProfile; divide out constant viscosity; force-normalise rhs to max absolute component=1 (zero case exact)
numerical_contract.residuals: independent ghost/central stencil momentum and full uncorrected cell divergence, not only MINRES info or algebraic augmented residual
numerical_contract.tolerance_basis: new registered residual limits exceed binary64 stencil round-off at the bounded tested grids while remaining far below measured O(h^2) continuum errors; separate momentum, continuity, gauge and work gates. They are not physical uncertainties or relaxed historical tolerances.
numerical_contract.work_units: force-normalised dimensionless mechanical work over the box; not a local heat source or thermal evolution
numerical_contract.range: finite scales/coefficient spectrum, velocity block condition estimate <=1e12, finite SI fields; unrepresentable conversions fail explicitly
numerical_contract.limits: owner-configurable per-request admission/work limits, not universal Atlas resolution ceilings; no automatic coarsening, weakening tolerance or backend substitution

analytical_cases.manufactured: psi=A sin(kx*x) sin(kz*z); u=psi_z, w=-psi_x; p=P cos(ax*x) cos(az*z). Derive continuous f=eta*(kx^2+kz^2)*v+grad(p), independently of the discrete matrix.
analytical_cases.expected_refinement: second-order velocity and pressure errors, asymptotic ratios approximately four; fixed independent continuous input, never regenerated expected answers from the solver
analytical_cases.rectangular: unequal physical extents/spacings, 2n by n cells, width=3 m height=1 m

primary_sources.used: rectangular isoviscous staggered Stokes layout, free-slip boundary and pressure-nullspace reference. Atlas derives its own trigonometric cases and implementation; tutorial code was not copied. PETSc's displayed forcing sign differs from Atlas's explicit f convention.
symmetric indefinite solve, preconditioner/callback/iteration-limit API. Installed SciPy 1.17.0 was inspected and tested; online page may describe a newer release.
explicit sparse CSC reference factorisation and repeated solve; not an added dependency

free-slip MAC sine/cosine diagonalisation and pressure Schur identity, independently checked against dense and sparse operators. This special-case preconditioner is not a claim about nonlinear, irregular or spherical systems.

bounded_execution.timing_scope: preparation (context, operators/factors), first complete call, then three reused complete calls including validation/residual/publication; not isolated process startup
bounded_execution.memory: existing WorkBudget; O(N) matrix-free path; explicit direct reference reserves conservative dense-fill 64*N^2 plus linear retained allowance before assembly. Not a process RSS cap.
bounded_execution.out_of_scope: no broad performance programme, R1 reacquisition, whole-world simulation, dependency installation or Windows/macOS claim

unsupported: nonzero normal boundary flow, no-slip, tractions or free surface
variable viscosity, yielding or damage feedback
coupled localisation or tectonic plate/terrain generation
platform/release acceptance beyond exercised Linux cases
